Name: amp-brutalist-dark-peach
Description: Neo-brutalist dark theme with a peach accent. Neo-brutalism is a web design style built on raw, honest shapes: thick black outlines, square corners, solid offset shadows with no blur, flat high-contrast colour and chunky bold type. This version uses tinted slate panels, Archivo Black headings, monospace labels and a toy-brick logo, and restyles every AMP screen: instances, status, console, file manager, settings, schedules, backups, store, analytics and login.
Author: Jayden
